verdict.rationale: Render's own docs describe a managed in-memory store aimed at shared caches and job queues, which covers the low-latency caching and queue use cases. Nothing in the pack says this store is Redis-compatible or key-value in API, which is a central part of the story. missing for 10: explicit evidence of Redis/protocol compatibility, key-value API documentation, depth on queue and persistence features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a Redis-compatible key-value store for low-latency caching and job queues

citations.quote: Low-latency in-memory storage ideal for shared caches and job queues.
